build_dir: per-slot: each slot keeps its own target/ (the default); never share CARGO_TARGET_DIR across slots. bin/gen-docs builds into target/gen-docs by default, so its docgen-feature binary never replaces the tested target/debug/forklift

schema-version.max_cmd: git show $REF:crates/forklift/src/output.rs | sed -n 's/^pub const SCHEMA_VERSION: u32 = \([0-9][0-9]*\);.*/\1/p'

warehouse-format.max_cmd: git show $REF:crates/forklift-core/src/util/warehouse_utils.rs | sed -n 's/^pub const WAREHOUSE_FORMAT: u32 = \([0-9][0-9]*\);.*/\1/p'

aws-format.max_cmd: git show $REF:crates/forklift-aws-lambda/src/format.rs | sed -n 's/^pub const AWS_FORMAT: u32 = \([0-9][0-9]*\);.*/\1/p'

mechanical_files.regenerate: git checkout --theirs tools/proof-load-desktop/Cargo.lock && cargo metadata --format-version 1 --manifest-path tools/proof-load-desktop/Cargo.toml >/dev/null && ./bin/check-no-aws-lc
